g.text: Progressive path tracing: a running mean that restarts when the camera moves
pt.comp adds one path per pixel per dispatch into an RGBA32F image (rgb = sum, a = count); pt_display.frag shows rgb / a.
so the old sum is overwritten, not averaged in.
while orbiting: 1 spp per frame, about 18.5 ms
Measured RMSE vs a 16 384 spp reference (640 x 360, docs/pathtracer-benchmarks.md): 1 spp 0.1018, 4: 0.0561, 16: 0.0326, 64: 0.0203, 256: 0.0119,
1024: 0.0068, 4096: 0.0040. Each 4x more samples cuts the error by about 0.57 (1/sqrt(N) predicts 0.5 for linear radiance).
The curve and the tiles are an illustration (simulated estimator, fixed seeds 7 and 11); the RMSE values are from real renders.
